movement.instructions: Choose horizontal movement. Normally RUN RIGHT, including over enemies; maintain momentum in jumps. If Mario is blocked against a wall whose top is too high to reach under the ceiling, move LEFT to get off the raised ledge and drop to the lower floor. Continue left if previous_decision.movement was brake_left and Mario is still on that ledge. Once falling below the ledge, return right to travel underneath the wall. Do not walk slowly toward enemies; run and jump instead.

criteria.brake_left: Retreat left to create space for a new jump.

start_jump.instructions: Is a jump needed RIGHT NOW? Only when Mario is grounded and jump_already_held is false. Enemy: use nearest_threat.dx (not horizontal_gap_px). Jump when dx is at most 40 pixels; wait when dx is greater than 40. Wall: jump when terrain.nearest_obstacle.distance_px is at most48 pixels. Pit: jump when terrain.nearest_empty_column_below_feet.edge_distance_px is at most48 pixels. Return false when no such nearby hazard exists. Being under a ceiling is not itself a reason to jump. Do not jump merely because an enemy is visible. Do NOT jump into a wall when its height_above_feet_px exceeds overhead_clearance_px: retreat and drop to the lower passage instead. Missing floor on a raised platform can be a safe drop if landing_surfaces shows continuous floor beneath; walk off rather than jumping into the ceiling. When moving left to drop off a ledge beneath an unjumpable wall, RELEASE jump and walk off; jumping would keep Mario trapped on the ledge.

ceiling_hop.instructions: Should Mario hop over a nearby enemy? True if grounded, jump button released, and an enemy is within 32 pixels. False otherwise.

sustain_jump.instructions: Is Mario rising? Hold jump while rising to gain height. Release jump while falling, grounded, or after hitting a ceiling.
